introduction_text: Complete this short form before your visit. Have a government photo ID and a recent photo of yourself ready — you'll upload both in step 3. Your host is notified as soon as you submit.
name: visitor-pre-registration-form
success_message: Your pre-registration has been received. We've sent a confirmation to your email. Your host will be notified for approval; you'll get an email once it's approved. Show that email at the gate when you arrive.
title: Visitor Access Pre-Registration

web_form_fields.label: Mobile Number
web_form_fields.description: Enter 10 digits (e.g. 9876543210). For international numbers, prefix the country code: +91 9876543210.

web_form_fields.label: Purpose of Visit
web_form_fields.description: A short reason, e.g. 'Interview for Software Engineer role' or 'Equipment delivery'.

web_form_fields.label: Vehicle Number
web_form_fields.description: Leave blank if arriving without a vehicle

web_form_fields.label: ID Proof Number
web_form_fields.description: Type the number exactly as printed on your ID.

web_form_fields.label: ID Proof Scan
web_form_fields.description: Upload a clear photo or scan of the front side of your ID. JPG or PNG, max 5 MB. Make sure the name and ID number are readable.

web_form_fields.label: Visitor Photo
web_form_fields.description: Upload a recent, clear photo of your face (front-facing, plain background). JPG or PNG, max 5 MB.

web_form_fields.label: Visit Category
web_form_fields.options:
Product Demo
Negotiation
Site Visit
Complaint
Audit

web_form_fields.label: Interview Type
web_form_fields.options:
Walk-In
Scheduled
Group Discussion
Technical Round
